{{missingInfo|1|enva}} {{Character Infobox |color={{Fire color}} |corecolor={{Fire color light}} |bordercolor={{Fire color dark}} |name=Rob |jname=ライ |tmname=Rai |text=fff |image=Rob.png |size=250px |caption=Rob |gender=Male |eyes=Brown |hair=Brown |hometown=Unknown |region=Unknown }} {{Character Infobox/Anime |color={{fire color light}} |series=''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]'' |debut=''[[HZ053|Hatenna and the Otherworldly]]'' |enva=Unknown |jpva=[[Ayane Sakura]] }} |} '''Rob''' (Japanese: '''ライ''' ''Rai'') is a minor recurring character who first appeared in ''[[HZ053|Hatenna and the Otherworldly]]''. He is [[Roy]]'s [[doppelgänger]]. ==History== [[File:Niko Rob Dash Annihilape HZ053.png|250px|left|thumb|Rob, Niko, and Dash being chased by an Annihilape]] Rob is a {{pkmn|Trainer}} who came from his home [[region]] to study at [[Naranja Academy]] in the [[Tera Training]] course. While traveling with his friends [[Niko]] and [[Dash]], the group became lost in the same forest as [[Liko]], [[Roy]], and [[Dot]]. After wandering aimlessly for a while, Niko used a vine from a nearby tree to replace a broken strap on her handbag. This sparked the fury of an {{p|Annihilape}}, as the vine was how it reached its food supply. The group was chased by Annihilape for days until they met Liko and her friends. Despite Roy's insistence that they battle the wild Pokémon together, Rob and his friends fled out of the forest. In ''[[HZ055|Showdown! The Paldea Elite Four]]'', Rob and his friends were welcomed by [[Clavell]] and [[Jacq]] along with the other students who had submitted their school reports and thus completed the first part of the training course. In ''[[HZ057|The Terapagos I Don't Know]]'', Rob, Niko, and Dash participated in [[Clavell]]'s speech that started the second part of Tera Training. In ''[[HZ066|Infiltrating the System! Naranja Academy in Danger!]]'', during the conclusion of the course, Rob, Niko, and Dash heard Clavell's speech regarding the [[Tera Training Student Battle Tournament]] that will be held for the course's students. In ''[[HZ067|Shine on, Terastallization! Liko vs. Roy!]]'', he faced Dot and her {{TP|Dot|Quaxwell}} during the tournament, only to be defeated. Rob reappeared in [[HZ126]], alongside Niko and Dash at Naranja Academy. He battled against Niko with his {{p|Darmanitan}} and later watched Dash battling Liko over whether the [[Strong Sphere]]'s would remain banned. Following Dash's loss, Rob supported Dash. In [[HZ136]], Rob, Niko, and Dash were seen helping take away discarded Strong Spheres after [[Spinel]] was defeated and his crimes were exposed to the public. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Rob |pkmn=Darmanitan |stage1=Darumaka |type1=Fire |img=Rob Darumaka.png |cap=Rob's Darumaka |img2=Rob Darmanitan.png |epnum=HZ053 |epname=Hatenna and the Otherworldly |vajp=Kohsuke Tanabe |vaen= |desc={{p|Darmanitan}} is Rob's only known Pokémon. In ''[[HZ067|Shine on, Terastallization! Liko vs. Roy!]]'', Rob used {{p|Darumaka}} in his [[Tera Training Student Battle Tournament]] battle against Dot, only to be defeated by her {{TP|Dot|Quaxwell}}. In [[HZ126]], it was revealed to have evolved into a Darmanitan. Darmanitan's only known move is {{m|Fire Punch}}.}} Rob has at least one other Pokémon, as he participated in the second phase of [[Tera Training]], which requires two Pokémon. ==Achievements== ===Tera Training=== Rob participated in the [[Tera Training]], his evaluation and overall score are: * Unknown [[Gym Leader]] - Battle Exam - Basic; ApprovedHe appeared among the students who passed the basic exam at Tera Training (prior to ''[[HZ055|Showdown!
